authority: meridian-telco legacy register (default for every resolved rule)

ROUNDING.default: per-line-item half-up to cents; total is the sum of rounded lines

PRORATION.default: fixed 30-day billing month, each part rounded to cents

OVERAGE_RATING.default: usage rounded up to whole GB (1024 MB), $10.00 per GB over allowance

MULTI_LINE_DISCOUNT.default: 3-9 lines 5%, 10+ lines 10% off the plan charge

LATE_FEE.default: no fee within 10 days of the due date, then 1.5% of prior balance

LOYALTY_DISCOUNT.default: loyalty_pct of the subtotal, subtracted after tax

PROVINCIAL_TAX_BASE.default: PST/QST on subtotal minus loyalty discount (legacy)

PROMO_EXPIRY.default: credit is live only in the calendar cycle it was issued (legacy)
PROMO_EXPIRY.alternative: credit is live for 30 days from issue (vantage)

SUSPENSION_CREDIT.alternative: suspended days credited at the daily rate (vantage)
